en: Nighttime winter scene of a tall, multi-tiered monument covered in deep snow. A robed figure stands on top of the column-like base, with multiple sculpted figures around the pedestal, all blanketed in snow. Leafless trees and park lights surround the monument, and in the background a warm-lit brick tower with arched windows and a crenellated roof rises above the trees. The sky has a reddish glow typical of city lights on a snowy night. A thin white frame surrounds the image, as is common in printed postcards.
